Original Taiwanese game art for "Tainan Gazetteer" (府城夜巡地圖), set in Tainan around 1930.
Style: handmade layered paper sculpture (紙雕 / kirie), the same for buildings, trees, plants,
fences and props. Every shape is a piece of cut paper: visible paper fibres, slightly soft
hand-cut edges, pieces overlapping in shallow layers with small soft contact shadows where one
sheet sits on another. Colour is printed on the paper: clearly visible risograph / stencil print
grain and uneven ink density across every flat area, never a clean digital fill.
Details are built from small cut pieces (roof tiles, bricks, window frames, leaves, petals,
wood planks), not painted lines.
Colour: follow the real object, then mute it: pale, slightly greyed, warm. Typical tones: warm
cream, pale brick red, coral, sage and grey-green, mustard, indigo, wood brown, stone grey.
No saturated red-against-green contrast.
Do NOT make: a 3D render or clay/plastic model, smooth bevelled relief, realistic or painterly
illustration, photo textures, thick foam layers, glow, glossy highlights, black outline strokes,
smooth gradients, depth of field.
Output: generated natively on a fully TRANSPARENT background (real alpha, no chroma-key colour
behind it, no coloured fringe), every object complete and separated by clear transparent
gutters, no ground, no base, no cast shadow outside the object, no text, no captions, no logos.
View: front-facing, very slight three-quarter, the same for every object on the sheet.

Single sprite: National Museum of Taiwan Literature (former Tainan Prefectural Hall). First three inputs are architecture references only (front entrance, full elevation with two small corner domes, side elevation). Fourth is palette only; fifth is paper craft style. Compress the wings to one bay each and tuck the two small domed corner towers close in. The whole silhouette is about 4:3. Central broad pale grey-green patinated mansard roof with a central dormer, triangular pediment, upper arched window between paired white Ionic columns, lower projecting rectangular portico on paired square and round cream-grey columns. The ENTIRE ground floor including corner tower bases is pale grey-white rusticated stone with horizontal joints. Dusty pale pinkish brick only in the upstairs wall insets between stone trim and window frames. Include individually cut masonry, quoin strips, roof seams and window mullions. No museum lettering or surroundings. Keep generous clear transparent margins.

Keep the recognizable five main floors plus compact rooftop tower, and keep silhouette width under 1.4 times height. No text, logos, flag, sidewalk or surroundings. One landscape sprite sheet, exactly six low, elongated, side-to-side repeatable pieces in an evenly spaced three-column by two-row grid, one distinct sprite centered in each of the six equal cells, with ample transparent margins and gutters. Order across first row: (1) wooden fence made of slightly irregular-height individual warm brown stakes and one or two horizontal rails, genuine transparent openings between stakes, (2) low dwarf ixora hedge made of overlapping tiny sage cut-paper oval leaves and a few small pale dusty red balls composed of four-petalled flowers, (3) pale dusty-red exposed-brick low wall with one visibly open decorative perforated brick segment. Second row: (4) bamboo fence with pale muted tan cut-paper bamboo stalks with joints, simple bindings and rails, (5) one low row of exactly three pots in terracotta and blue-and-white porcelain with papery pink bougainvillea bracts, a pinnate fern and a strap-leaved evergreen wannianqing, (6) compact orange jasmine hedge with dense overlapping pale green oval leaflets and sparse small white flowers. Reference 1 is style for paper tree trunks and layered foliage only, references 2 and 3 are wood fence construction only, and remaining pictures illustrate paper fibre style. Similar widths and low height. No ground or shadows below the pots or any other object. Plenty of vertical separation between rows. Native alpha through fence gaps and masonry openings.

Botanical requirement for the top-middle dwarf ixora: each small round flower ball contains about 12 tiny distinct four-pointed florets closely packed together, like a pompom of many miniature crosses, muted dusty coral red. Never use a handful of big individual flowers on this hedge. Narrow the leaf size and use more small overlapping smooth oval paper leaves. Align the left and right ends of the fence rails and wall for repeating sections, with the brick wall level across its ends. For the bottom-right hedge use small ivory five-petal blooms, much smaller than the leaves. Leave a prominent empty transparent gutter around all six grid cells.

臺灣文學館：以使用者附的正面、空拍及側面照片確認中央門廊、成對石柱、馬薩式屋頂、老虎窗與兩側圓頂角塔。百週年插畫僅供配色參考。縮短兩翼，保留一樓灰白石材、二樓淡粉紅磚與灰綠屋頂。台南旅遊網 https://www.twtainan.net/zh-tw/attractions/detail/1142/
林百貨：參考國家文化資產網及林百貨官方照片。保留淺褐溝面磚、圓弧轉角、橫向窗帶、圓窗與頂樓旗桿塔。https://nchdb.boch.gov.tw/city/TN/assets/overview/monument/19980626000004/ https://www.hayashi.com.tw/highlight.php
孔廟門：以東大成坊實景及歷史影像參考燕尾翹脊、紅牆、中央門洞與匾額位置。匾額留白，門洞透空。https://www.happytraveler.jp/2016/03/tainan-confucian-temple.html https://collections.nmth.gov.tw/CollectionContent.aspx?a=132&rno=2011.012.0185.0037
